title.en: The first direct detection of gravitational waves

rationale.zh: 双黑洞信号直接验证动态时空辐射，开启引力波天文学。
rationale.en: A binary-black-hole signal established dynamical spacetime radiation and gravitational-wave astronomy.

sources.title: The first direct detection of gravitational waves
LIGO: Gravitational Waves Detected 100 Years After Einstein’s Prediction
Celebrating 125 years of the Physical Review

dateNote.zh: 信号于2015年9月14日检测；首次公开与论文为2016年2月11日，轴采用2016年。
dateNote.en: Detected on 14 September 2015; first announcement and publication were on 11 February 2016, which sets the event year.

publisherCollections.title: Celebrating 125 years of the Physical Review

title.zh: 双中子星合并的多信使观测
title.en: Multi-messenger observations of a neutron-star merger

rationale.zh: 引力波、γ射线和千新星关联检验中子星合并及重元素起源。
rationale.en: Gravitational waves, gamma rays, and a kilonova tested merger physics and heavy-element origins.

sources.title: Multi-messenger observations of a neutron-star merger

dateNote.zh: 2017年8月17日观测，10月16日联合公开。
dateNote.en: Observed on 17 August 2017 and jointly announced on 16 October.

title.zh: 魔角扭转石墨烯的超导

rationale.zh: 可调莫尔能带产生关联绝缘与超导，开辟扭转电子学。
rationale.en: Tunable moiré bands produced correlated insulation and superconductivity, opening twistronics.

dateNote.zh: 按所引论文首次公开年。
dateNote.en: Dated by first public publication of the cited work.

rationale.zh: 地球尺度毫米波干涉测量解析黑洞附近的亮环与阴影。
rationale.en: Earth-scale millimetre interferometry resolved a bright ring and shadow near a black hole.

sources.title: ESO: First Image of a Black Hole (10 April 2019)

dateNote.zh: 数据采于2017年；首次公开图像为2019年4月10日，轴采用2019年。
dateNote.en: Data were collected in 2017; the first public image was released on 10 April 2019.

title.zh: 太阳CNO循环中微子的探测

rationale.zh: 直接测得CNO燃烧链的中微子证据，检验恒星核反应。
rationale.en: Neutrino evidence for CNO burning directly tested stellar nuclear reactions.

dateNote.zh: 按所引论文首次公开年。
dateNote.en: Dated by first public publication of the cited work.

title.zh: 惯性约束聚变靶增益超过一

rationale.zh: NIF靶丸聚变能量首次超过入射激光能，验证燃烧等离子体路线。
rationale.en: NIF fusion output first exceeded incident laser energy, advancing burning-plasma experiments.

dateNote.zh: 2022年12月5日实验，12月13日宣布；仅为靶丸层面的能量增益，不是整设施净发电。
dateNote.en: Experiment on 5 December 2022, announced on 13 December; this is target gain, not facility-wide net electricity.

title.zh: 纳赫兹引力波背景的证据
title.en: Evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background

rationale.zh: 脉冲星到达时刻的相关结构开启纳赫兹引力波观测窗口。
rationale.en: Correlated pulsar timing opened the nanohertz gravitational-wave observational window.

sources.title: Evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background

dateNote.zh: 2023年多组报告统计证据；背景天体来源和谱细节仍在检验，重要性暂定。
dateNote.en: Several arrays reported statistical evidence in 2023; source populations and spectral details remain under study, so importance is provisional.

title.zh: 低于阈值的表面码量子纠错

rationale.zh: 扩大逻辑存储码可降低错误率，为可扩展容错计算提供实验依据。
rationale.en: Larger logical memory codes reduced errors, supporting scalable fault-tolerant computation.

dateNote.zh: 2024年12月9日在线发表、2025年卷期；2026年更正图3a的重复码横轴及图例标签。此项记录逻辑存储实验，长期影响暂定。
dateNote.en: Online publication on 9 December 2024, in a 2025 issue; a 2026 correction fixed repetition-code axis and legend labels in Fig. 3a. This records a logical-memory experiment; long-term impact remains provisional.

rationale.zh: Λb衰变首次达到重子CP破坏的观测标准，扩展味物理检验。
rationale.en: Lambda-b decays established baryonic CP violation and extended flavour-physics tests.

dateNote.zh: 2025年3月公开，7月发表；是CP破坏的新体系观测，非标准模型之外的证明，重要性暂定。
dateNote.en: Announced in March 2025 and published in July; this extends CP tests to baryons and does not establish physics beyond the Standard Model.

title.zh: 杠杆与重心的数学静力学
title.en: Mathematical statics of levers and centres of gravity

rationale.zh: 将平衡问题转化为严格的几何论证。
rationale.en: Turned equilibrium problems into geometrical demonstrations.

dateNote.zh: 《论平面图形的平衡》的成书年份不详。
dateNote.en: The year of composition of On the Equilibrium of Planes is uncertain.

title.zh: 阿里斯塔克斯的日心构想

rationale.zh: 提出地球运动的早期宇宙模型；现存依据主要为后人记述。
rationale.en: An early moving-Earth cosmology known mainly through later testimony.

dateNote.zh: 没有可核验的单一发表年份。 历史思想记录，不作为已成立物理原理计入突破指数。
dateNote.en: No securely attested publication year. Historical proposal; excluded from the index of established physical advances.

title.zh: 比鲁尼的地球半径测量方法
title.en: Al-Biruni’s method of measuring Earth’s radius

rationale.zh: 将山高与俯角测量结合到地球尺度的几何估计。
rationale.en: Combined height and dip-angle measurements in a geometrical Earth estimate.

dateNote.zh: 具体测量年未可靠确定，未采用常见但不充分支持的单年。
dateNote.en: The measurement year is not securely established in the consulted source.

rationale.zh: 推进对持续运动及阻力的中世纪讨论，不等同牛顿惯性。
rationale.en: Advanced medieval accounts of persistence and resistance, distinct from Newtonian inertia.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — John Buridan

dateNote.zh: 论述见多次讲授及修订的作品，未强行指定单年。 历史思想记录，不作为已成立物理原理计入突破指数。
dateNote.en: The account occurs in repeatedly taught and revised works. Historical proposal; excluded from the index of established physical advances.

title.zh: 法里西的彩虹光学分析
title.en: Al-Farisi’s optical analysis of the rainbow

rationale.zh: 用实验模型和光路分析推进彩虹解释。
rationale.en: Advanced rainbow explanations with experimental models and ray paths.

dateNote.zh: 光学修订著作的单一年份缺乏足够核验。
dateNote.en: The optical revision has not been securely assigned a single year.

title.zh: 希罗的气动与蒸汽装置

rationale.zh: 记录压力驱动装置与反作用旋转装置。
rationale.en: Recorded pressure-driven mechanisms and a reaction-driven rotating device.

dateNote.zh: 《气动学》具体成书年份不详。
dateNote.en: The exact composition year of Pneumatica is uncertain.

title.en: Recognition of the precession of the equinoxes

rationale.zh: 通过跨时代观测比较识别天球坐标的长期变化。
rationale.en: Recognized secular changes through comparisons of observations across epochs.

dateNote.zh: 发现过程缺少可靠单年日期。
dateNote.en: The discovery process lacks a securely established single year.

title.zh: 后期墨家关于光影与成像的讨论
title.en: Later Mohist analysis of light and images

rationale.zh: 中国早期光学的系统论述；不是现代意义上的完整光学理论。
rationale.en: A systematic early Chinese treatment of optics, not a modern optical theory.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Mohist Canons

dateNote.zh: 约战国晚期；匿名后期墨家作品，不直接归为墨子亲作。
dateNote.en: Late Warring States compilation by later Mohists; not securely authored by Mozi.

title.zh: 用几何图示表示变化的运动量

rationale.zh: 以几何面积和图形分析均匀变化的量。
rationale.en: Used geometrical areas and figures to analyze uniformly varying quantities.

dateNote.zh: 相关手稿的成书年代不确定。
dateNote.en: The relevant manuscripts are not securely dated.

title.zh: 以水球实验解释主虹与副虹
title.en: A water-sphere explanation of primary and secondary rainbows

rationale.zh: 把单个水滴中的折射和内反射与虹的形成联系起来。
rationale.en: Linked refraction and internal reflection in drops with rainbow formation.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Dietrich of Freiberg
